overview.description: The Invesco Bloomberg Enhanced Fallen Angels ETF (IFLN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund tracks an index of high-yield corporate bonds downgraded from investment grade to high-yield. The index invests in USD-denominated bonds issued in developed markets and overweights those recently downgraded. IFLN was launched on Nov 15, 2007 and is issued by Invesco.
